An inverse-cube-root-convex density of positive mass under ηπ has a full-dimensional domain and compact closed support contained in T. The bounded representative lemma supplies the remaining regularity for the density centerpoint theorem.

For a full-dimensional log-concave finite measure, normalize its mass and apply the s=0 case of Borell's affine-support characterization to obtain a log-concave density.
